Schedule 6 Seasonal No Shooting Areas (Section 7)
Garibaldi Park
4 That portion of the Province of British Columbia in M.U.s 2-06, 2-07, 2-08 and 2-09 known as Garibaldi Park, during the period January 1 to August 31. [en. B.C. Reg. 162/87, s. 31.]
